question: Should this maintainer-updated head wait for fresh current-head real behavior proof and a resolved `check-test-types` result before merge?
rationale: The code path looks correct, but the available terminal proof predates the current head and the current CI failure was not inspectable from logs during this review.

options.title: Require current-head proof
options.body: Ask for updated terminal output, logs, or an equivalent redacted runtime transcript for the current head, then rerun or inspect `check-test-types` before merge.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer may accept responsibility for the current-head proof gap if they have separate local or Testbox evidence not visible on the PR.

options.title: Pause for CI diagnosis
options.body: Hold the PR until the failing type-check logs are available and a narrow fix or rerun decision is clear.

recommendation.title: Require current-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for updated terminal output, logs, or an equivalent redacted runtime transcript for the current head, then rerun or inspect `check-test-types` before merge.
